pages.en: At school, the teacher asks, "What job do you want when you are older?" Mia wants to be a singer. Sam wants to be a pilot.
pages.zh: 在学校，老师问：“你们长大后想做什么工作？”Mia 想当歌手，Sam 想当飞行员。
pages.scene: A bright classroom, the teacher smiling at the front, Mia singing into a pretend microphone, Sam holding a toy plane, other children laughing.

pages.en: Lily doesn't know. She likes drawing, animals and stories. At home she asks Dad, "What job is good for me?"
pages.zh: Lily 不知道。她喜欢画画、动物和故事。回到家，她问爸爸：“什么工作适合我？”
pages.scene: Lily sitting on the sofa next to Dad looking thoughtful, her drawings of animals on the table, Max with his head on her knee.

pages.en: "You can be a writer and an artist," says Dad. "You can write and draw books about animals!" Lily laughs. "That's a great idea!"
pages.zh: “你可以当作家，也可以当画家，”爸爸说，“你可以写书、画书，讲动物的故事！”Lily 笑了起来：“好主意！”
pages.scene: Lily at her desk happily drawing a picture book about a puppy, Dad looking over her shoulder and smiling, Max sitting by her chair.

questions.q: Sam wants to be a pilot.
Who does Lily ask at home?
Lily wants to write books about cars.
questions.zh: Lily 想写关于汽车的书。
